admitCard.where: From the careers page on the SBI website (sbi.co.in/web/careers), using your registration number and date of birth or password; no hard copy is posted
admitCard.when: About 10 days before each exam date, along with the 'Acquaint Yourself' booklet
steps: Open the careers page (sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings) and click the call-letter link for Junior Associate, Advertisement CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
Sign in with your registration number and date of birth or password.
Download the prelims call letter and the 'Acquaint Yourself' booklet, and print the call letter clearly.
Check your name, photograph, exam date, reporting time and centre address; report any discrepancy to the helpdesk (022-22820427, 11 AM to 5 PM on bank working days) or cgrs.ibps.in at once.
Keep the prelims call letter safe: it must be produced again at the Mains exam, authenticated by the centre staff.
carry: The printed call letter for that stage
An original photo ID with a self-attested photocopy
Two additional recent photographs identical to the one on the call letter
Nothing else: phones, calculators and smartwatches are not allowed inside
admitCard.note: Biometric verification (thumb impression or IRIS) may be done at the venue. At the Mains you must carry the mains call letter along with the authenticated prelims call letter and photo ID, and submit them; entry is refused without them.

answerKey.summary: SBI does not publish the question paper or an answer key for the Clerk exam, and there is no objection window. Unofficial keys from coaching sites give only a rough estimate, since scores are normalised across shifts.
steps: Follow the result announcements on the SBI careers page.

Individual marks are made available through the official marks lookup page on the careers site; open it when SBI activates it and enter your roll number and date of birth or password to download your score.
There is no provision for rechecking or re-evaluation of answers or scores.

result.summary: Each stage's result is announced on the SBI careers page as a roll-number list. Cutoff marks are not published; individual marks come only through the official marks lookup page. The Prelims is a screening stage and its marks are not counted in the final merit.

stages.what: Online test of 100 questions, 100 marks and 1 hour (English 30, Numerical Ability 35, Reasoning 35, with 20-minute sectional timing). No minimum qualifying marks per section are prescribed. About 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Mains in descending order of aggregate marks.
190 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours 40 minutes, with sectional timing. The result lists roll numbers of provisionally selected candidates state-wise and category-wise.

Provisionally selected candidates who did not study the opted local language in Class 10 or 12 take a qualifying LLPT at a centre in the State applied for, at their own expense (5% relaxation for reserved categories); those who fail are not appointed.

Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility. A wait list of up to 50% of vacancies is maintained for one year from the final result and released quarterly against non-joining and resignations. There is no interview.

result.scorecard: SBI publishes no cutoff or merit list for the Clerk exam. Marks from each phase are available only to individual candidates through the official marks lookup page on the careers site, and are kept there for a limited period, so download and save yours.
